arr_ops_doctor_root_shared_root: Another instance has the same folder and neither maps it
arr_ops_doctor_root_roots_unknown: Another instance's folders can't be read yet, so it can't be told whether it uses this folder too
arr_ops_doctor_root_hidden: Users who aren't administrators don't see its upcoming titles on the Calendar (set a path mapping or link libraries)
arr_ops_doctor_no_mappings: No path mappings are set for this instance.
arr_ops_doctor_sample: {title}: expected at {expected}, Jellyfin has it at {actual}
arr_ops_doctor_suggestion: Suggested path mapping (Sonarr/Radarr tab → this instance → Path mappings): {arr} → {jellyfin}
arr_ops_refresh_library_root: new folder in a TV library: left to Jellyfin's library monitor
arr_ops_refresh_left_to_scan: new folder in a library without real-time monitoring: Jellyfin adds it at its next library scan (or use Scan now)
arr_ops_refresh_scan_running: skipped: a library scan was running
arr_ops_refresh_new_folder_refresh: new series: one metadata refresh asked of Jellyfin
arr_ops_refresh_switched_off: not run: switched off while it waited
arr_ops_settings_line: Thresholds: not in Jellyfin after {pending} min · low disk below {disk}% free · Seerr OK without Sonarr/Radarr after {grace} min
arr_ops_remove_body: Remove {title} from {instance}'s queue. The download stays in the download client: its data is kept.
arr_ops_remove_pack: This download covers {scope}; removing it affects all {n} episodes.
arr_ops_remove_blocklist: Blocklist this release (it won't be grabbed again)
arr_ops_delete_body: This removes {title} from {instance}'s queue and deletes what the download client has of it. Partial data can't be recovered.
arr_ops_delete_blocklist: The release is blocklisted, so it won't be grabbed again.
arr_ops_not_in_queue: That download is no longer in the queue.
arr_ops_queue_changing: The queue is changing; try again in a moment.
arr_auto_shadow_override: Rollout guard on: automatic requests are only recorded (Shadow), nothing automatic is sent.
arr_auto_kill_all: Kill switch on: no automatic request is sent.
arr_auto_uncertain: {n} automatic sends waiting for a read-back (counted until settled)
arr_auto_uncertain_one: 1 automatic send waiting for a read-back (counted until settled)
arr_auto_seerr: Seerr handles requests: automation counts only the requests Jellyfin Enhanced sends to Seerr, and its kill switches and storage check hold only those. Once Seerr accepts a request, Seerr (and its Sonarr/Radarr) decide everything after that, so per-instance limits and stopping work after hand-off aren't available. Release-day searches need Sonarr/Radarr handling.
arr_auto_status_only: Status only: no automatic request is made.
arr_auto_accounting_unavailable: Automation can't count its budgets right now (database unavailable): nothing automatic is sent.
arr_auto_migration: Automatic requests were moved to recipe modes: next season {season}, next movie {movie}.
arr_auto_migration_grants: These Managers keep their automatic requests without an OK (recorded when their old automatic requests were on): {names}.
arr_auto_action_failed: That didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
panel_settings_lists_desc: Titles that aren't in the library yet, on playlists and collections.
panel_settings_lists_entries: Show titles not in the library on lists
panel_settings_lists_status: Show where each list title's request stands
panel_settings_lists_swapin: Let titles that arrive take their place in lists I turned this on for
arr_list_import_err_disabled: Importing lists is turned off on this server.
arr_list_import_err_fetch_limited: You've read a lot of lists in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
arr_list_import_err_format_changed: The list site changed how its pages are built, so this list can't be read right now. Nothing was changed; an update of Jellyfin Enhanced is needed.
arr_list_import_err_imdb: IMDb lists are turned off on this server. Mirror the list on MDBList and import that URL, or import an IMDb CSV export.
arr_list_import_err_letterboxd: Letterboxd has no API Jellyfin Enhanced can use. Add the list to MDBList (My Lists → External Lists) and import the MDBList URL, or export it as CSV on Letterboxd and import the file.
arr_list_import_err_list_not_found: That list wasn't found, or it is private.
arr_list_import_err_mdblist_not_public: MDBList doesn't share this list publicly. An administrator can read a private list through the MDBList API.
arr_list_import_err_metadata: Titles can't be looked up on this server: Jellyfin Enhanced needs a TMDB API key or Seerr for that.
arr_list_import_err_provider_disabled: Lists from this site are turned off on this server.
arr_list_import_err_provider_pinned: This list was linked through a source that can't be used now. Nothing was read through another site.
arr_list_import_err_rate_limited: The list site is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
arr_list_import_err_source_empty: The list site returned no titles. That isn't trusted as an empty list: try again later, or import the list another way.
arr_list_import_err_tmdb_key: This TMDB list needs a TMDB API key in the plugin settings.
arr_list_import_err_trakt: Trakt lists need a Trakt client ID in the plugin settings.
arr_list_import_err_unsupported: Supported: MDBList lists, TMDB lists, collections and charts, Trakt lists, watchlists and charts, Chronolists watch orders, and IMDb (if enabled).
arr_list_import_err_upstream: The list site couldn't be reached. Try again later.
arr_list_import_in_library_episodes: {count} episode in your library|{count} episodes in your library
arr_list_import_in_library_part: {count} of {total} episode in your library|{count} of {total} episodes in your library
arr_list_import_notice_imdb_unofficial: Read through IMDb's unofficial API: it may stop working without notice.
arr_list_import_notice_mdblist_api: Read with this server's MDBList key (counts against its daily quota).
arr_list_import_notice_seerr_fallback: Read through Seerr, because Jellyfin Enhanced has no TMDB key.
arr_list_import_reason_alternatives: Two versions: pick one or both
arr_list_import_reason_close: Another title is a close match
arr_list_import_reason_episode_id: IMDb episode ids need a TMDB API key
arr_list_import_reason_episode_title: Episode named by title: pick it with Change match
arr_list_import_reason_open_ended: The rest of the season couldn't be read
arr_list_import_reason_open_ended_trunca: The season is too long: only its first 1000 episodes are added
arr_list_import_reason_other_year: Released in another year than the line
arr_list_import_reason_type: Not the type the line names
arr_list_import_reason_unreleased: Not out yet: matched by its exact title
arr_list_import_reason_year_off: Released a year apart from the line
